verdicts.reason: A: the logo floats off-centre to the right while the headline is left-aligned and the CTA is centred, so the three share no axis. The top-left is dead space, and the Book Now button is jammed against a sliver of sea with white specks right under it. B has the same mixed alignment and a CTA crammed against the bottom edge, and is worse in two ways: the white Meridian logo sits on pale sky with almost no contrast, so the brand is close to unreadable, and a large empty blue band separates it from the text block.
